business_summary.text: Linc Ltd is one of India's oldest writing-instrument makers, with three manufacturing facilities and sales in over 50 countries; it also sells stationery and licensed brands and holds JVs with Mitsubishi Pencil (Japan), a Turkish partner (Silka) and Morris (Korea).

call_points.text: No formal guidance provided due to volatile input costs and geopolitical uncertainty
Passed on only 50% of price hikes to customers, with polymer prices easing
Management decided to await another quarter to gain visibility before providing formal guidance for FY27.
The West Bengal manufacturing facility is expected to become operational by Q3 FY27.
Corporate gifting and institutional sales moderated due to a high base effect.
Polymer prices, the principal raw materials, have risen due to supply-side disruptions.
No numeric revenue or margin guidance for FY27 was given in the presentation.
Operating EBITDA margin was 11.0% in FY26, down from 11.8% in FY25.
Mass writing instruments revenue fell 13.45% in FY26, while premium own brands were flat.

operating_notes.text: Linc's board approved a further USD 250,000 investment in Turkey JV Silka Linc on 27 April 2026, with partner Silka Kirtasiye Imalat Sanayi Ve Ticaret Limited Sirketi investing a matching USD 250,000.
New manufacturing unit near Kolkata requires ₹60.58 Cr investment with capacity addition slated for Q3 FY27.
FY26 share of JV losses was ₹3.76 Cr, versus ₹0.25 Cr in FY25.
Morris Linc Private Limited became a subsidiary from 4 November 2025 after a third amendment to the JV agreement; Linc On Ecommerce became a subsidiary from 8 July 2025.

FY26 revenue mix: premium own brands ₹257.08 Cr (flat YoY), mass own brands ₹108.22 Cr (-13.45%), licensed writing ₹89.86 Cr (+8.3%), other own brands ₹49.20 Cr (+11.5%), other licensed ₹21.77 Cr (-29.8%).
Pentonic's share of revenue rose to 34.4% in FY26 from 29.9% in FY25.
Net debt was negative ₹6.86 Cr at Mar-2026; net debt/operating EBITDA was (0.12).
Sales team was expanded by 125 personnel and split into two verticals (mass distribution and premium urban distribution) effective April 2026.
Cash conversion cycle stands at 65 days
-cUNI-LINC JV with Mitsubishi Pencil Company, Japan, exports account for more than 50% of revenue

timeline.summary: 27 Apr 2026: Linc's board approved a further USD 250,000 investment in its Turkey JV Silka Linc, matched by partner Silka Kirtasiye, leaving shareholding unchanged.
On 27 April 2026, Linc updated that its new manufacturing facility expansion near Kolkata requires ₹60.58 Cr and is targeted for completion by Q3 FY27.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹137.67 Cr, net profit ₹10.49 Cr.
26 May 2026: Linc reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹140.24 Cr and PAT of ₹10.46 Cr, recommending a ₹1.50 per share dividend.

27 May 2026: Linc's Q4FY26/FY26 strategy presentation showed FY26 operating income of ₹543.01 Cr (flat YoY), operating EBITDA of ₹59.49 Cr and PAT of ₹32.74 Cr, with the Kolkata plant still guided for Q3FY27.
Linc Limited’s Group Conference Call with Analysts/Investors on 27th May 2026 recorded and available via provided audio link.
On 27 May 2026, Linc reported Q4 FY26 consolidated operating income of ₹137.67 Cr and PAT of ₹10.46 Cr, recommending a ₹1.5 per share dividend.
Linc Limited’s promoters and persons acting in concert declared no encumbrance or pledge of shares during FY2025-26, signed by **Deepak Jalan** on 06.04.2026.
Linc Limited held Q1FY27 earnings call on 07 August 2026, reporting revenue of ₹138.95 Cr (+1.4% YoY) and PAT margin of 4.2% (-93 bps YoY)
On October 16, 2026, Linc Limited announced that Acuite Ratings reaffirmed its long-term rating at ACUITE A+/Stable and short-term rating at ACUITE A1+.
